races.name: Book Online At DundalkStadium.com Fillies Optional Claiming Race
Book Online At DundalkStadium.com Fillies Optional Claiming Race
races.verdict:
Preference is for RIVER TRIEUX, who bumped into a useful prospect at Cork second time up and Paddy Twomey's filly can leave her subsequent Fairyhouse effort behind dropped into claiming company. Joseph O'Brien saddles a couple and his recent C&D winner Eleanor Shelby rates as the main threat. Purely and Near Perfection can fight out third.

  1. RIVER TRIEUX
  2. ELEANOR SHELBY
  3. PURELY (IRE)

races.name: Halloween Mid-Term Racing Next Week Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
4-time course winner MEHMAN did well to get as close as he did when fifth over C&D a fortnight ago and lurking on a dangerous mark, he gets the tentative vote to end a lengthy losing sequence in reapplied blinkers. Rappell arrives on the back of a string of placed efforts, so Paul Flynn's 5-y-o could emerge as the main danger, with Eichan San and Faoladh another couple to consider, as well.

  1. MEHMAN
  2. RAPPELL (IRE)
  3. EICHAN SAN (IRE)

races.name: Braham Electrical Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
Preference is for BOSTON MAX, who proved at least as good as ever when just edged out at this course 7 days ago. He can build on that effort to resume winning ways, though Blue Anthem isn't taken lightly having shaped well here on his recent stable debut. The Cosy Corner completes the shortlist.

  1. BOSTON MAX (IRE)
  2. BLUE ANTHEM
  3. THE COSY CORNER (IRE)

races.name: Fastfix Quay Celtic 60th Anniversary Nursery Handicap
races.verdict:
PREMIER VIEW has proved a different proposition fitted with a tongue strap dropped to 5f, recording back-to-back wins at Down Royal, and he can continue his progress to land the hat-trick. The main danger could be Lake Lugano, who has shaped as if worth a try over this shorter trip, ahead of April Mist.

  1. PREMIER VIEW (IRE)
  2. LAKE LUGANO (IRE)
  3. APRIL MIST (IRE)

races.name: BAR 1 Betting Mercury Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
WASHINGTON HEIGHTS is a very solid operator at this level and arrives on the back of a creditable effort in Sweden, so gets the verdict over course specialist Sir Les Patterson, who was unlucky not to win a good minor event here earlier in the month. George Boughey's juvenile This Moment is a very interesting candidate pitched in against his elders.

  1. WASHINGTON HEIGHTS
  2. SIR LES PATTERSON
  3. THIS MOMENT (IRE)

races.name: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Maiden (Smullen Series)
races.verdict:
ASTROWAY made a promising start at Naas a fortnight ago and could be the way to go with improvement forthcoming. Battle Ready has a race in him, while Might Just Be is an interesting newcomer.

  1. ASTROWAY (FR)
  2. BATTLE READY (IRE)
  3. MIGHT JUST BE (IRE)

races.name: Des Byrne Memorial Maiden
races.verdict:
SAKOKU looks the pick at the weights in a wide-open maiden. Trustmore, Ask Me Again, Steel Cut and Cosmetic all look credible dangers.

  1. SAKOKU (IRE)
  2. TRUSTMORE (IRE)
  3. ASK ME AGAIN

meeting_summary.going: Soft-good to soft in places (prec inspection 8am)

races.name: Renegade Brewery Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: AMMOONY went the right way in her first 3 handicap starts before seeming stretched by the step up to 1½m at Goodwood last time, so she is taken to resume her progress back down in trip. She gets the vote ahead of Church Wedding, who remains with potential as she heads into handicaps, while Sax Avoidance could also be in the mix.

races.name: Pump Technology Handicap
races.verdict: Low-mileage 3-y-o ANYASI at least has form on soft ground, and he's taken to resume winning ways following an encouraging second at Haydock. Prosperitas should have conditions to suit and is feared most, while it'll be no surprise to see a bounce back from Mister Bluebird.

races.name: Follow BetVictor On Instagram EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: None of these are proven on the ground but CARBINE COUNTRY sets a fairly useful standard on his debut fifth. He gets the nod over Astabuen, who went close at Epsom on penultimate start, while it could be a baptism of fire for the newcomers if the forecast rain arrives.

races.name: Join Hot To Trot Racing 2027 EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Str)
races.verdict: Newcomer WELLINGTON SQUARE has a useful pedigree and could continue his yard’s recent success in this race (won last 2 renewals). Noble Mariner and Buxted Flyer are two other debutants to take seriously.

races.name: Get 2Up On Football At BetVictor Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: LIGHTNING TIGER seemed to relish testing conditions at Haydock last time and gets the verdict to follow up over Cliff Danger, who made his second start for Tom Ellis a winning one last time. The ground might've been against Besieged on his handicap debut and it would be no surprise if he gave a better showing this time.

races.name: Watch Weekend Winners Powered By BetVictor Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict: SHAFFRON looked a stayer to keep on the right side of when scoring at Haydock 4 weeks ago and David Menuisier's filly is taken to follow up. Autumn's Breeze ran much better than the market anticipated on her return at Kempton earlier in the month and is also shortlisted alongside recent Pontefract winner Noble Grace.

races.name: William Hill Epic Boosts Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
NORMAN FLETCHER has been knocking on the door from a much reduced mark in recent weeks, and he may well record a long overdue second handicap success. Crooked Path and East India Express are feared most among the home brigade, with Sunny South West the pick of the Irish trio.

  1. NORMAN FLETCHER
  2. CROOKED PATH (IRE)
  3. EAST INDIA EXPRESS (IRE)

races.name: Catesby Estates 'Chasing Excellence' Novices' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BOWENSONFIRE was easily the best of these over hurdles and he's also achieved the most over fences so far, so his claims are crystal clear. Bold-jumping front runner Passing Diamond could offer most resistance despite a double penalty.

  1. BOWENSONFIRE (FR)
  2. PASSING DIAMOND (IRE)
  3. JARRIVE DE MEE (FR)

races.name: Foundation Developments Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
THE HARDEST GEEZER has the strongest handicap form on offer, and he may well have the class to defy an 8-month absence. Wondering Why is in good hands and could prove the main threat if picking up where he left off last season. Continuance, Kapitein Kool and Fiveonefive all have recent match fitness on their side and need considering in a competitive renewal.

  1. THE HARDEST GEEZER (IRE)
  2. WONDERING WHY (IRE)
  3. CONTINUANCE

races.name: Oddschecker Novices' Hurdle (Grade 2) (Registered As The Sharp Novices' Hurdle) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
COOLTOBECARELESS burst clear in the manner of one ready for a higher-grade 2m novice on his recent hurdling debut at Chepstow and is taken to provide his top trainer with a third consecutive win in this race. Bells Grove was much improved when supplementing his Ballinrobe maiden success switched to a handicap at Navan last time and commands respect with the timefigure supporting the performance. Planters Punch went unbeaten in junior company last season and looks promising, too.

  1. COOLTOBECARELESS (IRE)
  2. BELLS GROVE (IRE)
  3. PLANTERS PUNCH

races.name: squareintheair.com Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CALICO can win this for the third successive season on his return with his chief rival JPR One keeping over half the field out of the handicap. Soul Icon may prove best of the others.

  1. CALICO (GER)
  2. JPR ONE (IRE)
  3. SOUL ICON

races.name: McCoy Contractors Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The form of MR HOLLYWOOD’s Galway win is proving strong and there’s surely more to come from him as a hurdler judged on his Flat ability, so he’s taken to come out on top. Kingstonian is a very interesting rival however, himself well above average on the Flat and open to plenty of improvement over this longer trip.

  1. MR HOLLYWOOD (IRE)
  2. KINGSTONIAN
  3. DATSTHEHOLYALLOFIT (IRE)

races.name: Chapel Down Amateur Jockeys' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
LITTLE LEDGEND has thrived for the recent switch to chasing and can extend his unbeaten record to 3. Fellow novice Fairlawn Skipper made a winning chase bow in good style at Kelso last month and he looks the other potential improver in the field, while Unanswered Prayers is lurking on a dangerous mark on return.

  1. LITTLE LEDGEND (IRE)
  2. FAIRLAWN SKIPPER
  3. UNANSWERED PRAYERS (IRE)

races.name: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd January 2027 Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
BATTLE STANDARD proved a different proposition switched to a handicap for the first time when bolting up at Southwell 8 days ago and escaping a penalty for that, he looks to hold serious claims again with the prospect of more to come. Palliser similarly improved a chunk on his first start in a handicap when second over C&D recently and he's feared. Ballybunion may well complete a clean sweep for the 3-y-os. Yehudi may emerge best of the rest.

  1. BATTLE STANDARD
  2. PALLISER
  3. BALLYBUNION (IRE)

races.name: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd January 2027 Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Not for the first time of late, ERNIE'S VALENTINE shaped really well when posting a very good third at Southwell 2 weeks ago, travelling smoothly before paying the price for a big move into contention. Evidently down to a handy mark, he's selected to end a losing run. Tommo's Ginjaninja ran right up to his best when second at Redcar recently and he's a threat. Baloo's Blues and Typeface complete the shortlist.

  1. ERNIE'S VALENTINE
  2. TOMMO'S GINJANINJA
  3. BALOO'S BLUES

races.name: All Weather Championship Is Back EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
JAHAMI stepped up on her debut effort when staying on well for second at Southwell 17 days ago and promising to stay further still, she can make it third time lucky with the prospect of more to come for her top yard. Wishful Thinker finished a place behind the selection latest and she's next best, with Lady Perdita and Good Magic Moment a couple of the newcomers to note.

  1. JAHAMI
  2. WISHFUL THINKER
  3. LADY PERDITA

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
races.verdict:
STONEY WOOD and From Me To You both contested races that have worked out well last time. Michael Bell's charge is narrowly preferred with Billy Loughnane back in the saddle, while a case can also be made for Ard As A Rock and Hollieisthedollie on the pick of their respective efforts.

  1. STONEY WOOD (IRE)
  2. FROM ME TO YOU (IRE)
  3. ARD AS A ROCK (IRE)

races.name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
races.verdict:
INTERVENTION ran his best race for some time and looked unlucky not to finish closer in the process when third at Beverley 2 starts ago and, with his latest Ripon run best overlooked, Mick Appleby's 3-time C&D winner is too well handicapped to ignore back on all-weather. Methgal has been a model of consistency since joining Dylan Cunha and is an obvious threat. Willolarupi and Cayman Tai are others to consider.

  1. INTERVENTION
  2. METHGAL (IRE)
  3. WILLOLARUPI (IRE)

races.name: Midnite Aint Your Grandads Bookie Selling Handicap
races.verdict:
JODHPUR BLUE has managed only one career victory but is a much more solid proposition on all-weather and took a step in the right direction at Southwell in first-time cheekpieces 8 days ago, so looks the pick in this lowly contest. Three-time course winner R P Mcmurphy produced a rare below-par effort last time but will be a threat if bouncing back and seeing out the longer trip, while Freddy Robinson can continue his consistent spell.

  1. JODHPUR BLUE (FR)
  2. R P MCMURPHY
  3. FREDDY ROBINSON

races.name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
races.verdict:
HAUTELUCE is thriving on all-weather and can make it 4 wins in a row on this surface against several older rivals. Arcadian Nights is the oldest runner in the field but lurks 2 lb below his last winning mark and has Billy Loughnane back aboard, while Canvas is interesting back on all-weather.

  1. HAUTELUCE (FR)
  2. ARCADIAN NIGHTS
  3. CANVAS

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
SO SASSY won twice over C&D in the summer and ran a cracker when second at Yarmouth over 6f 11 days ago so she looks to have an excellent chance of resuming winning ways back up in trip. Hilltop is a reliable sort who was denied a clear run when second here last time and could well get involved despite a tough draw, whilst Velvet Rhythm is also respected given she's unexposed on all-weather.

  1. SO SASSY (IRE)
  2. HILLTOP
  3. VELVET RHYTHM

races.name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
races.verdict:
SAXOPHONIST has been knocking firmly on the door for a while now and seemed well suited by the step up to this trip last time so he's a pretty strong fancy here assuming the run of the race doesn't go too much against him. Mountbatten is the main danger if that situation unfolds and he could prove hard to peg back, while Arouse is still learning and will do better at some stage.

  1. SAXOPHONIST (IRE)
  2. MOUNTBATTEN (GER)
  3. AROUSE (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Extra Places Every Day Nursery
races.verdict:
MIND THOSE STEPS ran a cracker when mid-field in the listed Two-Year-Old Trophy at Redcar 3 weeks ago and a literal reading of that excellent effort suggests he's well handicapped back in a nursery. Bulletsnap is the type to go on progressing so he's a huge threat, with Glamorize another to consider.

  1. MIND THOSE STEPS
  2. BULLETSNAP (IRE)
  3. GLAMORIZE (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Epic Boosts Handicap
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for plenty, but last year's winner FINE INTERVIEW has largely held his form since making a winning reappearance over C&D in the spring and with his usual cheekpieces reapplied, Hamad Al Jehani's 5-y-o can record career victory number 7. City Captain has taken his form up a notch in recent weeks, so he heads up the dangers, with Advertised and Pilu another couple to consider, too.

  1. FINE INTERVIEW (FR)
  2. CITY CAPTAIN
  3. ADVERTISED (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap
races.verdict:
If there's a runner with the potential to be a lot better than their mark it's handicap debutant PALLADAS given he's created an excellent impression when successful both starts on all-weather. Murashah has made an excellent start for Ed Bethell and he can offer most resistance, while Invictus Gold could benefit from more severe headgear.

  1. PALLADAS
  2. MURASHAH (IRE)
  3. INVICTUS GOLD (IRE)

races.name: ''What Are The Odds'' By Alan Newman EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Charlie Appleby saddles a couple of very interesting contenders, with William Buick presumably opting for the experience of DESERT ROMANCE over well-bred newcomer Snow Carnival. She's therefore the percentage call, with Fortis Fortuna and Macha'Allah also appealing debutantes.

  1. DESERT ROMANCE
  2. SNOW CARNIVAL
  3. FORTIS FORTUNA (IRE)

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
None of these have fancy entries but this looks a deep back-end novice which should be dominated by newcomers. Before market clues, the strikingly-bred ENTRUST (By Dubawi and Enable's first runner) is preferred to Godolphin pair Age of Reason and Zajal.

  1. ENTRUST
  2. AGE OF REASON (FR)
  3. ZAJAL

races.name: William Hill Price Boosts Every Day Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
BIG HARRY looks potentially useful so he remains with plenty of scope off a mark of 82. Most of these should handle the conditions, including main dangers Topwarrior and Alpha Magic.

  1. BIG HARRY
  2. TOPWARRIOR
  3. ALPHA MAGIC

races.name: William Hill Price Boosts Every Day Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Another fiendishly-competitive sprint in which it could pay to take a chance on GO VINCE GO, who has dropped to a career-low mark and Tim Easterby's 3-y-o promises to be suited by this return to 6f. Angel Gabriel took his form up a level when scoring at Windsor recently and having backed that up when third at Haydock since, he can provide most resistance. Almarada Prince and Lipsink round off the shortlist.

  1. GO VINCE GO (IRE)
  2. ANGEL GABRIEL (IRE)
  3. ALMARADA PRINCE (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Keep Your Raceday Positive Handicap
races.verdict:
DRYBURGH was unlucky not to score here in June and could hardly have shaped better when finding only one too good at Bath last time, so is taken to get off the mark in this competitive event. Mayaada is another leading player under a penalty, with Unchartedterritory also holding strong claims on the back of 2 improved efforts.

  1. DRYBURGH (IRE)
  2. MAYAADA (IRE)
  3. UNCHARTEDTERRITORY (IRE)

races.name: Sligo Fillies Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
BABY PEARL took a big step forward from her debut when second at Wexford 11 weeks ago and with the prospect of more to come, looks the way to go. Ronnie's Rascal is an obvious contender for Willie Mullins, while Casheldale Lass (behind the selection at Wexford) could be in the hunt again.

  1. BABY PEARL (IRE)
  2. RONNIE'S RASCAL (IRE)
  3. CASHELDALE LASS (IRE)

races.name: Abbey Haven Care Centre & Nursing Home Hurdle
races.verdict:
FRIARY ROAD didn't go on from an impressive hurdling debut last season, but he could be worth another chance on just his fifth start in this discipline. Speisialta looks dangerous if putting it all together, while Combs is a player on the pick of his form.

  1. FRIARY ROAD (IRE)
  2. SPEISIALTA (IRE)
  3. COMBS (IRE)

races.name: Callan Tansey Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
SOLAR GENERATION remains unexposed after just a handful of starts and is worth forgiving his handicap debut in August having been badly hampered mid-race, so he looks worth chancing in an open contest. Veteran Bella Union is feared most after a largely solid spell since the spring with Pralognan also respected with blinkers on first time since his time in France.

  1. SOLAR GENERATION (IRE)
  2. BELLA UNION (IRE)
  3. PRALOGNAN (FR)

races.name: Callan Tansey Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
THE FLYING RAMBLER shaped encouragingly in a maiden last time and, with improvement expected now handicapping, looks worth chancing in an ordinary contest. Atlantic Wonder rates the main danger if seeing out this slightly longer trip with High Honour respected given his past course form and some help from the handicapper.

  1. THE FLYING RAMBLER (IRE)
  2. ATLANTIC WONDER (IRE)
  3. HIGH HONOUR

races.name: John Thomas McNamara Series (Q.R.) Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
LA MULETA has made a promising start to her career, only just edged out by a well-backed hurdling debutant at Fairyhouse last time, and she could be ready to get off the mark. High Kick Kev was successful in a Clonmel bumper on Rules debut and is feared most, ahead of Gunnery Sergeant.

  1. LA MULETA (FR)
  2. HIGH KICK KEV (IRE)
  3. GUNNERY SERGEANT (FR)

races.name: End Of An Era Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
GOIN’ has been knocking on the door and shaped well from off the pace when third in a Navan handicap last time, so he is taken to open his account, with consistent pair Larkins Lane and Demanding Gerry feared most. Any support for unexposed Magic Hands Noel would also be worth noting.

  1. GOIN'
  2. LARKINS LANE (IRE)
  3. DEMANDING GERRY (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
ITS TIME FOR A RUN was much improved when second at Fairyhouse 3 weeks ago and there is more to come again from the promising novice. Up in trip, he gets the vote over frustrating chaser Union Station.

  1. ITS TIME FOR A RUN (IRE)
  2. UNION STATION (IRE)
  3. REMEMBERWHAT (IRE)

races.name: Solar Generation Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
ILBDARE can make the most of his return to a C&D over which he is 2-2, especially after looking better than ever when third at Roscommon 25 days ago. Broken Ice is feared most after a solid Fairyhouse third and is likely to be suited by this step back up in trip, while Mickey Cohen, who finished a place ahead of Broken Ice there, should again be thereabouts.

  1. ILBDARE (IRE)
  2. BROKEN ICE (IRE)
  3. MICKEY COHEN (IRE)

races.name: Lucky Fish Plinko Maiden Plate (F & M)
races.verdict:
WILLOW VALLI produced another solid effort at Scottsville and she seems very likely to give her running. Lady Nancy could give the selection most to think about, while Chooks Kiss comes into calculations for minor honours.

  1. WILLOW VALLI (SAF)
  2. LADY NANCY (SAF)
  3. CHOOKS KISS (SAF)

races.name: Bet With Colossus Pools Exclusive On www.tote.co.za Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
SEED SEEKER has recorded some excellent efforts lately and is arguably the one to beat. So Indi is the most prudent second choice, while Roxbury Park might well have a say as well.

  1. SEED SEEKER (SAF)
  2. SO INDI (SAF)
  3. ROXBURY PARK (SAF)

races.name: Gallop TV Maiden Plate (F & M)
races.verdict:
REMUNERATION just sbout sets the standard so gets the tentative nod to open her account. Spot Me In The Sky might be the answer to second place , while Glitter Paint is perhaps the most interesting other runner in the field.

  1. REMUNERATION (SAF)
  2. SPOT ME IN THE SKY (SAF)
  3. GLITTER PAINT (SAF)

races.name: Bet With Tote www.tote.co.za Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
J LORDI produced his best effort for some time when runner-up over C&D 2 weeks ago so he could be the answer. Belligerent may offer most resistance, while Queraristinyferari edges it so far as third place is concerned.

  1. J LORDI (SAF)
  2. BELLIGERENT (SAF)
  3. QUERARISTINYFERARI (SAF)

races.name: Pinkdrive Apprentice C Stakes
races.verdict:
MOJO MAN is in a good run of form and is just about the pick in this field. Chara Sands looks the likeliest to finish second, while Vision To Achieve shouldn't be far away.

  1. MOJO MAN (SAF)
  2. CHARA SANDS (SAF)
  3. VISION TO ACHIEVE (SAF)

races.name: Online Form Guide www.galloptv.co.za D Stakes
races.verdict:
PRAISE DE LA REY has the best form so has a lot in her favour. Satellite World could be the answer to second place, while Record High is not out of it where the places are concerned.

  1. PRAISE DE LA REY (SAF)
  2. SATELLITE WORLD (SAF)
  3. RECORD HIGH (SAF)

races.name: Lucky Fish Fortune Cup C Stakes
races.verdict:
CHASING GOLD is pretty exposed but arrives at the top of her game, so a bold bid is surely forthcoming. Charlie Bucket and High Queue head the opposition.

  1. CHASING GOLD (SAF)
  2. CHARLIE BUCKET (SAF)
  3. HIGH QUEUE (SAF)

races.name: Hollywoodbets Bright Future Apprentice D Stakes
races.verdict:
SAUDI SWEEP is just about the best hope here taking everything into account but this is an open race. Stage One is the most realistic next preference, while Born Of Fire also has claims.

  1. SAUDI SWEEP (SAF)
  2. STAGE ONE (SAF)
  3. BORN OF FIRE (SAF)

races.name: Welcome To Nelson Mandela Bay Open Maiden
races.verdict:
DESTREGA stands out by some way on form on the back of a pair of excellent runner-up effort and is up to winning this. American Gem could be the answer to second spot, while Green Point might be worth siding with for third.

  1. DESTREGA (SAF)
  2. AMERICAN GEM (SAF)
  3. GREEN POINT (SAF)

races.name: youcanbetonus! Graduation Plate
races.verdict:
POINTER is useful at her peak and while she hasn't been in top form of late, she still looks the one to be with. Action America could be the answer to second place, while Rhydian is the other candidate for the three.

  1. POINTER (SAF)
  2. ACTION AMERICA (SAF)
  3. RHYDIAN (SAF)

races.name: Tickets At Howler For The Betway Summer Cup Open Maiden
races.verdict:
RARE EARTH has been operating at a good level lately and is the one they all have to beat. Lady Of Fate looks second best on balance, while Freestyle Dance is perhaps the most interesting of the others.

  1. RARE EARTH (SAF)
  2. LADY OF FATE (SAF)
  3. FREESTYLE DANCE (SAF)

races.name: Racing Today Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
CHATTERBOX has put together a solid series of recent efforts and is the one they all have to beat. Malibu Ice seems the leading threat, while Worldly edges things for third.

  1. CHATTERBOX (SAF)
  2. MALIBU ICE (SAF)
  3. WORLDLY (SAF)

races.name: Tab Telebet 011 074 0300 Mr 67 Handicap
races.verdict:
SAY A PRAYER holds a convincing advantage on the form book and has outstanding claims. Remind Me Of You is hard to ignore in the search for second, while Atlantic Pearl is another that could go well.

  1. SAY A PRAYER (SAF)
  2. REMIND ME OF YOU (SAF)
  3. ATLANTIC PEARL (SAF)

races.name: Betway Summer Cup 28 November Middle Stakes
races.verdict:
MAKHACHEV looks marginally the best in this field but any trouble could put paid to his chance. Policy Of Truth is the obvious danger, while Sabrage shouldn't be ruled out.

  1. MAKHACHEV (SAF)
  2. POLICY OF TRUTH (SAF)
  3. SABRAGE (SAF)

races.name: Play Soccer 6, 10 And 13 Fm 90 Handicap (F & M)
races.verdict:
EAST COAST GIRL's recent runs have been likeable on the whole and seems likely to take the beating. Spoil Yourself rates the main opposition, while Fantine looks third best.

  1. EAST COAST GIRL (SAF)
  2. SPOIL YOURSELF (SAF)
  3. FANTINE (SAF)

races.name: Next Fairview Racemeeting Friday 30 October Fm 74 Handicap (F & M)
races.verdict:
ROCK ME MAMA is operating at a good level lately and has a fair chance. Potenza is the most pragmatic second choice, while Alex Miller also demands a closer look.

  1. ROCK ME MAMA (SAF)
  2. POTENZA (SAF)
  3. ALEX MILLER (SAF)

races.name: Race 9 - Bank Of America Valley View Stakes - Grade 2
Longines Equita Lyon C.h.i. - Prix Rouvignac Handicap - Awt
Prix De Saint Rambert-l'ile-barbe Handicap - Awt
Prix Du Haras De Poujux Maiden Stakes - Awt
Prix De La Roseraie Stakes - Awt
